h: Actress Laide Olabanji meets Peter Obi and says he is Nigeria's next president
p: Nollywood actress Laide Olabanji has reportedly met Peter Obi and publicly declared that she stands with him ahead of 2027. Her endorsement has drawn mixed reactions online, with Obi supporters cheering while others questioned the timing.
more: She told her followers that Nigerians should give Obi a chance.
Celebrity endorsements are becoming a feature of the 2027 campaign season.
